title: Maintenance
description: Show a maintenance page on every domain of this service, instead of the app. The containers keep running.
enabledHint: Visitors get this page with a 503 status. Nothing is redeployed.
activeHint: Visitors see it instead of the app on every domain.
pageTitleHint: Leave empty for a standard message in the visitor's language.
subtitle: Subtitle
logoHint: A PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG image of at most 128 KB, stored inline so the page loads nothing else.
hideLinksHint: Removes the “Try again” link under the message.
savedHint: Applied right away, without a deploy.

errors.css: This CSS is too long or contains </style.
errors.logo: Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG image.
errors.logoTooLarge: That image is larger than 128 KB.
errors.logoUnreadable: That file could not be read.
